subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly Xiamen Airlines via Xiamen to Kunming and travel through Pu’er and Xishuangbanna, then ride the high-speed train (2nd-class seats) into Laos for Luang Prabang and Vientiane, and back to Kunming by train. Stay in 5-star hotels (one night in a 4-star hotel in Xiamen) and enjoy one complimentary bottle of water per person per day. This tour covers both China and Laos.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 11–19 2026 to Dec 11–19 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xiamen
items: Fly Manila to Xiamen (MF820, 21:15–23:35) and meet the tour guide at the airport
Transfer to hotel and check in (hotel arranged by Xiamen Airlines)

itinerary.title: Xiamen – Kunming – Pu’er
items: Fly Xiamen to Kunming (MF8405, 07:45–10:55) and meet the tour guide at the airport
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Pu’er – Xishuangbanna
items: Wild Elephant Valley Scenic Area (one-way cableway included)
Dai Ethnic Garden (electric shuttle bus included)
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Xishuangbanna – Luang Prabang
items: High-speed train from Xishuangbanna to Luang Prabang, 2nd-class seats (lunch not included)
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Luang Prabang – Vientiane
items: Xiangman Village (basic hand-making and foot bath included)
High-speed train from Luang Prabang to Vientiane, 2nd-class seats
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Vientiane – Kunming
items: High-speed train from Vientiane to Kunming South, 2nd-class seats (lunch not included)
After dinner, transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Kunming – Xiamen – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport and fly Kunming to Xiamen (MF8406, 12:25–14:45)

placeDesc.Wild Elephant Valley: A forest nature park in Xishuangbanna, entered with a one-way cableway.
placeDesc.Dai Ethnic Garden: A village-style park in Xishuangbanna showing Dai culture, with an electric shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Starlight Night Market: A night market in Xishuangbanna for local snacks and souvenirs.
placeDesc.Phou Si Mountain: A hill in the middle of Luang Prabang with a temple on top and views over the town.
placeDesc.Sisavangvong Night Market: A handicraft night market on Luang Prabang's main street.
placeDesc.Royal Palace Museum: The former royal palace of Luang Prabang, now a museum.
placeDesc.Xiang Thong Temple: Luang Prabang's best-known temple, famous for its sweeping roofs and mosaics.
placeDesc.Weaving Village: A village near Luang Prabang known for traditional weaving; handmade items are at your own cost.
placeDesc.Kuang Si Waterfall: A tiered waterfall with turquoise pools south of Luang Prabang.
placeDesc.Luang Prabang Morning Market: A local morning market in Luang Prabang, visited with the alms-giving activity.
placeDesc.Xiangman Village: A village stop near Luang Prabang with basic handicraft making and a foot bath included.
placeDesc.Xiangkun Temple: A temple visited on Day 7 in Vientiane.
placeDesc.That Luang Temple: The golden stupa of Vientiane, a national symbol of Laos.
placeDesc.Vientiane Arc de Triomphe: Patuxai, Vientiane's victory monument modelled on the Arc de Triomphe.
placeDesc.Mekong River Night Market: A riverside night market in Vientiane along the Mekong.
